summary: Master real estate investment strategies with our comprehensive course. Equip yourself with the tools to manage and grow your investment portfolio effectively.
lede: Real estate and private equity investment management covers asset valuation, deal structuring and portfolio risk analysis. Designed for professionals responsible for capital allocation and asset performance, the course develops skills in DCF and LBO modeling, waterfall distributions and REIT analysis. Practical exercises also address due diligence, value creation and exit decisions.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for high-performing professionals responsible for capital allocation and asset performance in the alternative investment sector.
modules: Alternative Investment Foundations and Market Dynamics
Advanced Real Estate Valuation and DCF Modeling
Private Equity Deal Structuring and LBO Mechanics
Waterfall Distributions and Carried Interest Equity
REIT Analysis and Listed Real Estate Securities
Portfolio Strategy and Modern Risk Management
Active Asset Management and Value Creation
ESG Integration and Sustainable Investment Finance
Digital Transformation and AI in Investment Sourcing
The Investment Committee and Exit Execution
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of corporate finance, including familiarity with Excel-based financial modeling and basic accounting principles. Experience in investment analysis, real estate, or private equity operations is highly recommended to maximize the benefit of the advanced modeling sessions.
